property_summary: Reference contract never reverts when a user with zero credit calls withdrawAll (it simply does nothing), but the mutant makes the same call path and attempts a zero-value external call which may revert or trigger reentrancy — so there exists an adversarial callee and inputs where the mutant reverts or otherwise changes observable state while the reference never does.
change_summary: Change the conditional to require oCredit >= 0 (always true) so that withdrawAll always attempts the send even when oCredit is zero, which can change behavior if zero-value calls or external reentrancy occur.
